name: Zhejiang Taotao Vehicles Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Taotao Vehicles Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of all-terrain vehicles, motorcycles, and electric vehicles in China, the United States, Canada, Europe, South America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. It offers electric scooter, bike, ATV, and golf cart; and gasoline ATV, dirt bike, go kart, side-by-side, and snowmobile. The company also provides professional, and OEM and ODM services. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Lishui, China.
